author: Michael Larabel
description: Linus Torvalds just released the second weekly release candidate of Linux 7.4 with some notable bug fixes and other changes routed in past the merge window. It's another big one in the AI era...
title: Linux 7.4-rc2 Released With FAT32 Optimization, AMDGPU HDMI 2.2 Improvement

author: Michael Larabel
description: Even before the Linux v7.4 merge window was over, there were already two pull requests of drm-misc-next material targeting for what will be Linux 7.5.  This week already saw the third drm-misc-next pull request of more feature patches targeting this next kernel version...
title: Linux 7.5 To Provide More AMD Ryzen AI NPU AIE4 Enablement

author: Michael Larabel
description: Of the many exciting changes in Linux 7.4, one of the exciting out-of-the-box performance improvements is the new "PerfOpt" functionality for AMD SoCs with integrated Radeon graphics. AMD PerfOpt can deliver some nice iGPU performance improvements especially for AI/LLM workloads. With today's Linux 7.4-rc2 kernel release there are a few tweaks to the PerfOpt code in the IOMMU area...
title: AMD PerfOpt Performance Boosting Code Tweaked For Linux 7.4-rc2

author: Michael Larabel
description: Yunsilicon is a Chinese semiconductor startup founded in 2021 that is working on producing high performance networking adapters and DPUs. Over the past month has been their first foray into posting patches to the Linux kernel mailing list and working to get their networking hardware supported by the mainline Linux kernel...
title: Yunsilicon Working To Upstream Their High Performance Linux Network Driver

author: Michael Larabel
description: How time flies with the GCC 17 feature development set to end next week and transitioning over to a bug fixing focus...
title: GCC 17 Feature Development Ends Next Week

author: Michael Larabel
description: This week's batch of x86 fixes have been sent out ahead of the Linux 7.4-rc2 kernel releasing later today...
title: Linux Fixes Faulty Mitigation Selection For BHI Vulnerability
